summary: Iter30 Wave2 backend validation: 19/19 tests PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_iter30_wave2_badge_filters.py. Verified: (1) /api/shops badge filter params ltg/deals/wholesale/verified — isolation + ltg+deals intersection, (2) /api/shops without filters still enriches has_active_promo + has_wholesale on every shop, (3) /api/restaurants badge filters ltg/deals/verified — expired promo restaurant excluded from ?deals=true (date-window enforcement), (4) /api/products?ltg=true only LTG products, /api/products?deals=true excludes expired promos and includes live percent + BOGO, (5) /api/homepage/featured-products returns list<=limit, includes exchange_rate_ssp, all in-stock, only from Verified shops, LTG product ranked in top-5 via +50 boost, (6) Composite shop ranking A(LTG+verified)>B(verified+15 completed orders+rating5)>C(verified+15 cancellations), (7) Regression: shop enrichment flags + restaurant has_live_promo+has_active_promo alias intact, (8) Empty featured returns [] gracefully.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_shops enrichment runs 5 aggregates (orders completed/cancelled, favorites, promo, wholesale) per request — acceptable for the current data scale but should move to a materialised summary collection or cached view when shop count grows beyond a few hundred.

list_shops applies ltg/verified via mongo query but deals/wholesale are Python-side post-filters after slice-window fetch — with a wide range of shops paginated deep, ?deals=1 could yield an under-filled page; pagination cursor semantics could be revisited.

homepage_featured_products uses $unwind on orders.items for two aggregates over all completed+cancelled orders — will not scale well with a large order history; consider persisting order_count/cancellation_count on the product doc via a background job.
seed_data_creation: Per-run ephemeral prefix TEST_iter30w2_<uuid>. 3 shops (A=LTG+verified, B=verified high-orders/rating, C=verified high-cancellations), 7 products (live promo, expired promo, wholesale, LTG, BOGO, plainB, plainC), 3 restaurants (LTG, deals with live promo menu-item, plain with expired promo menu-item), 15 Completed orders on shop B, 15 Cancelled orders on shop C. Hard delete_many teardown across users/shops/restaurants/products/menu_items/orders/restaurant_orders/favorites/reviews/splits.
